text: The schedule of meeting dates for the 2019 Toronto Urban Health Fund Review Panel is as follows: - April 5, 10, and 15, 2019 (one meeting over three days) - May 7, 2019 Meetings will be held at City Hall, 100 Queen Street West, and begin at 9:30 a.m. There will be a 15 minute recess at 10:30 a.m. and at 2:30 p.m. Lunch recess is one hour, starting at 12 noon.
The Toronto Urban Health Fund Review Panel received the schedule of meetings for 2019 for information.
